negativeControls.noise: Independent uniformly distributed -1/0/+1 rep; unchanged true strength, load, RIR and prescription; no fatigue.

recommendation.reason: No available 2.5 kg equipment increment fits the model's 2–5% change. Keep this load or use a smaller increment.

fineEquipment.reason: Anchor reached or exceeded the cap at its assigned RIR. Increase load 2.5% and restart at 5 reps.

bodyweight.reason: Bodyweight anchor reached the cap. Progress difficulty or choose weighted/assisted mode; no external load is assumed.
